research_question: How can an equity-constrained, climate-robust land-sea intervention portfolio reduce coastal pressures and protect ecosystem and livelihood safeguards?
constraints: Do not claim a portfolio has already improved an ecosystem.
Do not treat MPAs, blue carbon, recycling, or nutrient controls as universal substitutes.
Retain source setting, geographic transfer limits, and climate uncertainty.
Treat consent, participation, capacity, monitoring, and equity as decision variables.
Use design-only computational framing and abstain for missing evidence.

evidence_capsules.signal: plastic requires circularity and policy levers
blue carbon has governance and valuation conditions
MPA outcome depends on governance and capacity
social science, equity, and observing matter
